scope: Skin-only CU LRC 6.7.6 window lifecycle and reuse of an already running provider.
classification: Skin/provider lifecycle defects; no removed Kodi API claimed.
fixes: Remove the CU-specific hidden-button Action(back) during initial focus.
Set Skin Lyrics state on CU window load, including automatic background-service display.

For selected CU LRC only: request culrc.force on a running provider with closed GUI; avoid redundant RunScript while already running. Preserve generic RunScript for other configured providers and CU when not running.

source_interpretation: The script manager indexes paths to invocation IDs, inserts a path on execute and erases that path when an invocation finishes. A redundant short entry can remove a path still used by the background invocation. This is a source-derived explanation of the observed StopScript failure, not a debugger trace.
provider_contract: CU's existing default.py sets Home culrc.force=TRUE when its service is running and GUI is closed; gui.py main_loop consumes that request. The skin mirrors that existing request branch without launching another invocation.
helper_limit: A separate intermediate OSD reopen race was corrected by waiting for actual close; it is retained as lyrics_background_before_osd_wait.json.
limits: Only unchanged CU LRC 6.7.6 with authored local LRC is tested. No online scraper or other configured lyrics provider run.
The CU running/gui/force properties are implementation-specific; no stable future API guarantee is inferred.
Generic other-provider dispatch is retained by the selector conditions, with no new provider-specific action for those targets.
System.CurrentWindow captions for dynamic Python windows are diagnostic labels, not action targets; no power action executed.
No Kodi or external add-on code modified.
Only duplicate entries from the three corrected skin controls are prevented; external callers of the same provider are not controlled.
